remarks: Looking for a charming and renovated place to live in the Cove neighborhood of Stamford? Look no further. This renovated 2 bedroom, 1.5 bath home features quartz kitchen countertops, stainless steel appliances, hardwood floors, and in-unit laundry. The main level of this features a spacious living room, eat-in-kitchen, half bathroom, and laundry area. On the upper level, you'll find two bedrooms and a full bathroom with double vanity. 2 off-street parking spaces included within a shared driveway. Landlord covers all exterior maintenance & trash. Good credit, income verification, background check, and rental application are required. Schedule a tour before it's gone. 1 months security. Tenant pays electric. Trash and water included.
